name: flag-learn
description: Flag Learn – an interactive geography learning app. The other day, I felt like learning more flags of the world, but the apps I came across weren't quite to my liking (most of them were just about choosing answers). For me, the most effective way to learn new things is to constantly rewrite them, and the key factor is r

paragraphs: An interactive educational quiz game built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Master world geography, flags, capitals, and even the night sky through engaging game modes and spaced repetition!
features: Higher or Lower chain: Optional stats-only quiz route (/higher-lower) comparing population or land area between flags (bundled local dataset — see Data & licenses); hot streak, mistakes, and elapsed timer during the run.

Unambiguous daily puzzles: Daily Connections picks its four categories from data with complete membership (data/flags.json + data/countryStats.json), then drops any country that would also fit another category that day…

Feedback you can reason from: Daily Deduction answers a guess only with facts known for every country in the pool — region, subregion, population, area, and the bearing between two centroids (data/countryCentroids.json,…

One score per day: The Gauntlet seeds all four rounds from the date, so everyone plays the same run. Mid-round state is persisted, so a refresh resumes where you were instead of handing back a free retry, and the total…

A board derived from the map, not hand-drawn: World Conqueror's 168 territories and their borders come out of public/world-map.json in three passes (scripts/gen-neighbours.mjs): land borders from shared TopoJSON arcs —…

whatItDoes.text: An interactive educational quiz game built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Master world geography, flags, capitals, and even the night sky through engaging game modes and spaced repetition!

requirements.text: 🏅 Highscore: Timed speedruns for world flags, world capitals, or US state flags—track mistakes, accept a time penalty on errors, and post your best time to shared leaderboards (no login).
